summary: Explains the two ways to provide the API token and server when publishing: in ansible.cfg via galaxy_server_list (most secure) or on the command line (insecure because secrets can be exposed).
questions: What's the safest way to store my Galaxy API token?
Is it safe to pass my Galaxy token on the command line?

answer_card.title: Where to specify the publishing token
answer_card.answer_md:
- **Configuration** (recommended): put the token in a `galaxy_server_list` entry in `ansible.cfg`.
- **Command line**: pass it to `ansible-galaxy`. This is insecure because secrets typed on the command line can be seen by other users.
